name: grounding
description: Pixel-accurate segmentation grounding via spectral thresholding. Given an image and a text description of a region of interest (e.g. 'water', 'vegetation', 'urban'), produces a binary mask for the matching land-cover class computed from real pixel values (classical CV, not a trained segmentation model).

image_path.description: Path to the input satellite image

text_prompt.description: Natural language description of the region to segment (e.g. 'water bodies', 'built-up area')

return_bbox.description: Also return a bounding box around the mask

mask_path.description: Path to the output binary mask (PNG)

bbox.description: Bounding box [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in pixel coordinates

mask_area_px.description: Number of positive pixels in the mask

confidence.description: Brightness contrast between masked and unmasked regions, as a crude distinctness signal
